# `passportsim serial`

Read new console output from a cursor, or write bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_serial` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/serial` |
| Scenario step | `serial.write` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim serial <op> [--cursor <CURSOR>] [--hex <HEX>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--max-bytes <MAX_BYTES>] [--newline] [--stream <STREAM>] [--text <TEXT>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | `--cursor <CURSOR>` | `integer` | no | Byte offset. |
| `hex` | `--hex <HEX>` | `string` | no | Bytes as hex pairs. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `max_bytes` | `--max-bytes <MAX_BYTES>` | `integer` | no | Largest read (8192). |
| `newline` | `--newline` | `boolean` | no | Append a newline (false). |
| `op` | `<op>` | `"read"` \| `"write"` | yes | What to do. |
| `stream` | `--stream <STREAM>` | `"usj"` \| `"uart0"` | no | Console (usj). |
| `text` | `--text <TEXT>` | `string` | no | Text to write. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/serial.input.json`](../schema/commands/serial.input.json).

## Examples

### Read what the guest printed since the last call

```sh
passportsim serial --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "read"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "read"
}
'@ | passportsim serial --json -
```

### Send a line to the guest

```sh
passportsim serial --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "newline": true,
  "op": "write",
  "text": "ping"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "newline": true,
  "op": "write",
  "text": "ping"
}
'@ | passportsim serial --json -
```
